verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for documentation tools, since hosted docs platforms can offer region selection, so the axis applies. Docusaurus itself documents no region or residency controls. It only generates static files that users deploy to third-party hosts of their choosing, which is a host-platform or user-side arrangement rather than a product capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
